decision: D1: automatic acquisition, Overture only, release 2026-10-21.0

deployed.migration: none (kind overture-stage reused; blockedReason geometry_pending needs no schema change)
deployed.backup: pg_dump -Fc of ot_directory taken before deploy (scratchpad s10/ot_directory_pre_acq.dump)

liveAcquisitionBlocker.summary: Host and container egress to the Overture S3 bucket (and example.com, github.com) timed out for the whole verification window; the npm registry stayed reachable. The extractor's pinned range proxy therefore got a 502 on its HEAD request and the runs ended failed_retryable.
liveAcquisitionBlocker.consequence: No town went unknown to available, and no succeeded_empty or partial town was observed live. Those transitions are covered by postgres tests against a scratch database with a fake extractor.
liveAcquisitionBlocker.publicListingsRoute: The listings route is /internal/local-evaluation/towns/:id/listings (gateway: directory/towns/:id/local-evaluation-listings). It reads staged rows and does not depend on publication, which stays paused.

afterEgressRecovery.note: Host egress to the Overture S3 bucket returned at about 10:10 UTC; the worker resumed the backlog with no operator action.
